title: Market Sentinel: model convergence signals & field reconnaissance playbook
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Context: Over the last two quarters multiple open and proprietary model providers have released overlapping capabilities in short-context summarization, retrieval-augmented generation, and structured JSON output. We need a repeatable playbook to detect 'model convergence' (when multiple providers reach parity on a capability), assess operational risk/opportunity, and run targeted field reconnaissance in priority regions and verticals.

Goal: Produce a Market Sentinel playbook that: (1) defines observable convergence signals and thresholds, (2) enumerates prioritized field probes and synthetic workloads by vertical and region, (3) specifies telemetry and dashboards to track signal progression, and (4) delivers decision triggers for procurement/rollout experiments and fallback strategies.

This ticket is to create the PM deliverables and coordinate with SRE/research/solutions engineering to execute the initial probe batch.
acceptance_criteria: Signal taxonomy document (PDF/Confluence) with 7+ observable convergence signals and numeric thresholds for escalation
A prioritized list of 12 field probes mapped to verticals, regions, and customer archetypes (market-facing repo + playbook)
Telemetry spec and dashboard mock (Console dashboard wireframe) that shows signal velocity, provider overlap, and customer latency-cost delta
Decision rules (yes/no triggers) for: run canary onboard, open procurement, start fallbacks testing, and notify enterprise success teams
steps: Run a 48-hour synthetic workload across 6 candidate models (short-context RAG, JSON-structured responses, token-efficiency) in US, EU, APAC to measure parity metrics

Define convergence signals (examples: <5% delta on Top-1 correctness on prompt suite; consistent latency within 1.2x of Redwood-verified model; embeddings cosine delta < 0.02 across top-10 for search queries)
Map existing customer cohorts and verticals to probe priority (finance, healthtech, legal first due to compliance sensitivity)
Coordinate with Research to add new prompt families that stress 'edge behaviors' (hallucination under constrained context, multi-step instruction fidelity)
Build dashboard mock in Console (trace links, per-model latency/cost bucket, overlap heatmap) and hand off to observability squad
Draft communication templates for Sales/Customer Success for 'convergence observed' and recommended mitigation/offerings
Schedule two-week field reconnaissance run and collect metrics, notes, GitHub PRs, and customer feedback artifacts
